Yoga for Knee Pain | Knee Strengthening & Mobility | 40-Min Daily Yoga
Do you find it difficult to sit on the floor or climb stairs? Do your knees feel stiff, weak, or uncomfortable?
If yes, then you are in the right place.
Our knees do so much for us every day. We walk, sit, stand, climb stairs, bend, and move around without even thinking about it. But sometimes, with age, inactivity, or lack of strength, our knees can start feeling stiff, weak, or uncomfortable.
